description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator class, which implements configuration logic for the email subscription menu within the OrangeHRM admin module. It overrides a screen in the module, specifically for email notification viewing purposes.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for email subscription, utilizing the module screen helper trait to override screen behavior.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewEmailNotification' within the module, returning null.
